job.title: [Post] WE ARE HIRING | SFCC FRONT-END DEVELOPER - MNC JoulestoWatts is hiring experienced profess…

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | Headless & PWA Commerce APIs | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SFCC FRONT-END DEVELOPER
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SFCC Front-End Developer opportunity through JoulestoWatts. With over 5 years of professional e-commerce development experience delivering scalable solutions for major multinational enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in building robust web applications and integrating headless APIs.

bullets.label: Headless & Front-End APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, connecting backend commerce services with modern user interfaces.

bullets.label: PWA & Storefront Integration
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC Web Services for Headless Commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, ensuring seamless multi-channel user experiences.

bullets.label: Platform Customization
bullets.text: Customized Backoffice components, authored Groovy administrative scripts, and engineered frontend and backend functionality following enterprise best practices.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on cloud portals within agile DevOps workflows, collaborating closely with international cross-functional teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce expertise adds value to your client.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and front-end integration experience to JoulestoWatts and your leading MNC client. My background building scalable headless solutions and high-performance web applications at Rockwell Automation and Shell aligns strongly with your technical needs for this role.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience, headless API development, and robust front-end integration expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to deliver high-impact results for your client.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Nivedha, I am an experienced e-commerce developer with 5+ years building robust web applications and headless APIs for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am very interested in the SFCC Front-End Developer role and would love to connect. My notice period ends December 15, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SFCC FRONT-END DEVELOPER - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Nivedha D,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the SFCC Front-End Developer position. With over 5 years of experience building scalable enterprise e-commerce platforms, headless APIs, and PWA integrations for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to deliver strong results for your MNC client.

I hold a valid German work permit and can start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to our conversation.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
